transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, I guess what brings me in is that... well, most nights, after my wife goes to bed, I end up in the kitchen. And I just eat way, way past a normal plate of food. 

Like, if there's fried chicken, mac and cheese, sweet potatoes, rolls, or whatever leftovers are in there from an event or something... I just keep eating. I'll eat until a whole tray is empty, or like half the food in the fridge is just gone.
When this happens, do you feel unable to stop eating or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, that's exactly it. It's like... once I take that first bite, it feels like the decision has already been made for me. Even while I’m standing there telling myself, 'George, stop now,' my hands just keep fixing another plate or opening another container. I just can't seem to stop.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. Um, I just end up feeling really sick and uncomfortably full, but I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that.
After you overeat like that, do you ever do anything to try to undo it, like taking laxatives?
No, I don't take laxatives. I don't really do anything like that to try and undo it. I just deal with feeling terrible afterward.
When these eating episodes happen, do you prefer to eat by yourself because you feel embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Um, I'm not really sure. I mean, I'm usually by myself at home anyway during the day. But I haven't really noticed that I purposely hide away from people to eat just because I'm embarrassed. It just kind of happens when the urge hits me, whether anyone is around or not.
Do these eating episodes upset you a lot?

Yeah, they really do. Um, afterward I just feel sick with myself. It's like... I'm this man everybody sees as organized and strong, but then I'm just sitting there feeling ashamed and guilty. I get really disgusted that I let it happen again.
During these episodes, do you eat an amount of food that most people would consider unusually large for the situation?

Yeah, I do. Most nights when my wife goes to bed, I end up in the kitchen and... I eat way past a normal plate. It's definitely an unusually large amount. Like, I'll eat fried chicken, mac and cheese, sweet potatoes, rolls... just whatever event leftovers are in there. I'll just keep eating until a whole tray or half the fridge is gone. So, yeah, it's a lot.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?
Yeah, like I was just saying a minute ago, they really do. It causes a lot of distress. I just feel incredibly guilty and disgusted with myself after it happens.
How often do these eating episodes happen?
Well, for months now... I really can't think of a single week where it didn't happen at least once. And most weeks, honestly, it's been several nights a week, usually right after my wife goes to bed.
